genericIdentifierCorrection.source: validator g.rs valid_identifier and context.rs case_whodrug_keys

rules: Never append text to code_set, boolean, date, numeric, NullFlavor, vocabulary, or identifier fields.
Vocabulary and coded identifier B must be selected from the active real lookup/release and differ from A; absence of a second result is a clear blocker.
NullFlavor B comes only from the existing per-code dictionary list.
Numeric B preserves the declared numeric representation; audit comparison separately maps declared decimal DTO strings to DB JSON numbers.
MedDRA code/version fields are paired: use two active codes under the same active 28.1 release; do not increment code or version numerically.
Generic ICH MPID/PhPID fields are format-validated identifiers and are not WHODrug membership fields. Only MFDS-specific mfds_mpid fields bind to active WHODrug products.
scope: Source-derived valid alternate-B planning for the current 299 contract_rows fields; no live mutation. Values requiring terminology or identifier membership are deliberately unresolved.
